component.name: Point Hub
component.summary: The console of the LedBox scoreboard

description.p: Point Hub is the console of the LedBox scoreboard: the screen the scorer's table runs the board from.

It finds the scoreboard by itself, on the board's own Wi-Fi or on the cable, also when that network has no internet, and shows the board's console: the game on the board, the link to an OpenVolley eScoresheet match, the history, diagnostics and settings. The Game tab is drawn natively; the other tabs are the board's own pages.

ul.li: Points, sets, timeouts and substitutions on the board
Games from the season's schedule, or typed in
Backups of every game, exported as a zip

description.p: It needs the scoreboard: on its own, the app only looks for one.
